cobalt.$description: You are here. Current set ring, active tab, selected rows, switch on.

lime.$description: You can press this. Start, log, done, save. Nothing else is lime.

danger.$description: Delete, Discard, Erase, field and keypad errors.

swipe.$description: Behind a set swiped to delete.

outline.$description: Control outlines, empty rings. Never text.

high.$description: Calendar days, progress tracks, fills inside workout cards.

muted.$description: Secondary text: subtitles, rest, dates, placeholders.

cobalt-tint.$description: Cobalt at 25%: active tab pill, selected row. Use text on it, not muted.

lime-tint.$description: Circle behind a done set's check.

long2.$description: ms. Live bar container transform in.

medium2.$description: ms. Tab fade-through, shared axis X.

set-lands.$description: ms. Signature move on Done. Never blocks input.

short4.$description: ms. Digit odometer, sheet out, reduced-motion crossfade.

emphasized.$description: M3 emphasized (path easing in Compose: EmphasizedEasing).

press-scale.$description: Scale while pressed. No bounce anywhere (MotionScheme.standard).

full.$description: M3 full: pills, chips, 56dp buttons, progress bars. Code: CircleShape / 50%.

large.$description: M3 large: hero cards (active set card, Home week card, photos).

medium.$description: M3 medium: list cards and rows, stepper buttons, stat tiles.

small.$description: M3 small: keypad keys, done-set rows, inputs, snackbars.

target.$description: Minimum tap area. Chips draw 36 inside it.

section.$description: Between sections. 8 inside a group vs 24 between groups.

stack.$description: Inside a set row; related blocks.

stack-tight.$description: Between items in one group: rows, cards in a stack.

emphasis.$description: Active set card and selected-row border (cobalt).

outline.$description: Chip and selectable outlines (readable in dim gyms).
